condition: so.Stack combined with a mark that has a non-zero baseline (e.g. so.Bar(baseline=10)) doesn't add the baseline back to the stacked values, so stacked bar heights come out wrong and the first bar can disappear.
workaround: Subtract the baseline from the data yourself and use the default baseline of 0 with so.Stack. Or patch Stack._stack so it sets df[other] = df["baseline"] + stacked_lengths.
